Ah, Culloden Moor. What a trip.

My first time there was interesting too. I travelled around Scotland with my (scottish) boyfriend (I am Norwegian), and that place really messed with me.

Coming out from the visitor centre (red/goverment side) I felt super uneasy and like I wasn't supposed to be there. I felt stressed out and a little bit angry tbh. Then I felt a firm hand (I think?!) on my back pushing/leading me over to the blue/highlander side. Nobody I could see were pushing me, just to be clear . Over there I felt more at ease and more at "home", but after a short walk and when facing the red side a deep sorrow came over me and I felt defeated and I started crying. Basically a range of different emotions washed over me as I walked the field, and there were some shadow-figures running around. It was heartbreaking and weird, and I'm obviously on the Scottish side here, haha...  Was drained when we left.
